QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (memory_buffer_alloc.c:566–600) ... With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` it installs the `_mutexed` wrappers, which lock a mutex around each call (memory_buffer_alloc.c:541–552)."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the mutexed wrappers are installed with MBEDTLS_THREADING_C. It never says a plain pair is installed otherwise, and it doesn't say the choice is made at compile time inside the init function.
